title: Committee of Supply – Head T (Ministry of National Development)
what_it_is: Committee of Supply – Head T (Ministry of National Development)

sections.label: Housing linked to key policies
sections.summary: Housing is linked to CPF, education, employment, ethnic integration and social mobility, and in 1959 the PAP Government prioritised employment and housing.

sentences.speaker: Mr Alex Yam (Marsiling-Yew Tee)
sentences.text: Many key policies like the Central Provident Fund (CPF), education, employment, ethnic integration, social mobility are intimately linked with housing.

sentences.speaker: Mr Alex Yam (Marsiling-Yew Tee)
sentences.text: When the People’s Action Party (PAP) was elected as the Government in 1959, it had two key priorities – provide employment and house the people – to feed and to shelter.

sections.label: Unemployment protection for housing loans
sections.summary: The Member suggests HDB work with MOM and CPF on a Home Protection Scheme variant including an unemployment protection clause for major recessions.

sentences.speaker: Mr Alex Yam (Marsiling-Yew Tee)
sentences.text: The current financial assistance measures by the Housing and Development Board (HDB) may not be sufficient.

sentences.speaker: Mr Alex Yam (Marsiling-Yew Tee)
sentences.text: I, therefore, suggest for the Ministry to work with the Ministry of Manpower (MOM) and CPF on a variant of the Home Protection Scheme for coverage beyond catastrophic loss of income, due not only to physical incapacity or death, but also include an unemployment protection clause in the event of major recessions.

sections.label: Enhanced Lease Buyback Scheme applications
sections.summary: The Enhanced Lease Buyback Scheme introduced in April last year is a step in the right direction, but statistics show close to 1,000 applications so far.

sentences.speaker: Mr Alex Yam (Marsiling-Yew Tee)
sentences.text: The Enhanced Lease Buyback Scheme, which was introduced in April last year to help them further monetise this, is a step in the right direction.

sentences.speaker: Mr Alex Yam (Marsiling-Yew Tee)
sentences.text: However, the last available statistics indicate that we only have close to 1,000 applications so far.

sections.label: Five proposals for families
sections.summary: The Member lists five proposals: employment counselling, priority childcare, 85% school attendance, marriage and family support, and bigger flats with shorter leases.

sentences.speaker: Mr Alex Yam (Marsiling-Yew Tee)
sentences.text: One, full-fledged employment counselling programme to address job difficulties that these families face; two, community-based childcare or infant care facilities that they have priority for so that we will allow mothers to go back to work with ease of mind; three, minimal 85% school attendance for children to make them future-ready; four, enhance marriage and family stability through social work support; and lastly, five, bigger flats, with shorter leases beyond the 2-room flexi, to provide flexibility especially for those with larger families.

sections.label: Housing market cooling measures and supply
sections.summary: The Member notes no mention of relaxing property market crimps, agrees with lifting the Additional Buyer's Stamp Duty, and calls for steady supply and a stabilised market.

sentences.speaker: Mr Alex Yam (Marsiling-Yew Tee)
sentences.text: Lastly, the Finance Minister made no mention of relaxing the crimps on the property market, despite having cooled down the bubble significantly.

sentences.speaker: Mr Alex Yam (Marsiling-Yew Tee)
sentences.text: As I mentioned earlier, housing affects all sectors, a slowdown in the housing sector is a slowdown across many sectors.

sentences.speaker: Mr Alex Yam (Marsiling-Yew Tee)
sentences.text: My hon colleague Mr Christopher de Souza, among others, has called for the lifting of the Additional Buyer's Stamp Duty to stimulate demand.

sentences.speaker: Mr Alex Yam (Marsiling-Yew Tee)
sentences.text: I agree, as the Total Debt Servicing Ratio and loan limits will still go along the way to calibrate the market.

sentences.speaker: Mr Alex Yam (Marsiling-Yew Tee)
sentences.text: Let us move into the next five as a community.

sentences.speaker: Mr Alex Yam (Marsiling-Yew Tee)
sentences.text: I reiterate my call to continue a steady supply to meet demand, keep costs affordable, broaden choices for different home owner groups and promote all-round community building to achieve better homes for all.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chong Kee Hiong (Bishan-Toa Payoh)
sentences.text: First and foremost, we must ensure that the housing market is stabilised.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chong Kee Hiong (Bishan-Toa Payoh)
sentences.text: When the market was rising, cooling measures were necessary in preventing a housing bubble.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chong Kee Hiong (Bishan-Toa Payoh)
sentences.text: But now, with a more subdued market, we have to respond quickly to prevent the market from further decline.

sections.label: Public rental flat supply
sections.summary: The Member asks whether the Ministry plans to ramp up the supply of public rental flats to cut waiting time.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chong Kee Hiong (Bishan-Toa Payoh)
sentences.text: Does the Ministry have plans to ramp up the supply of public rental flats to cut waiting time?

sections.label: HDB flat pricing and maintenance
sections.summary: Asks how HDB would keep flats attractively priced and estate maintenance costs affordable without significant escalation.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chong Kee Hiong (Bishan-Toa Payoh)
sentences.text: How would HDB ensure that with more and better facilities, the flats remain attractively priced and running estate maintenance costs remain affordable and will not escalate significantly over time?

sections.label: Lease top-ups and EC prices
sections.summary: Asks if the Government would consider lease top-ups for older flats beyond SERS, and notes concerns that EC prices may exceed middle-income reach.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chong Kee Hiong (Bishan-Toa Payoh)
sentences.text: Would the Government consider lease top-ups for older flats, in addition to the SERS programme, as not all precincts are suitable for SERS?

sentences.speaker: The Chairman
sentences.text: Mr Gan Thiam Poh, you have four cuts.

sentences.speaker: Mr Gan Thiam Poh (Ang Mo Kio)
sentences.text: However, there are concerns that the price of ECs may be getting beyond the reach of middle-income Singaporean households.

sections.label: Home ownership rate statistics
sections.summary: States that the home ownership rate of resident households is 90.8%, while noting the 9.2% who do not own homes.

sentences.speaker: Mr Gan Thiam Poh (Ang Mo Kio)
sentences.text: According to the latest statistics, the home ownership rate of resident households in Singapore is 90.8%.

sentences.speaker: Mr Gan Thiam Poh (Ang Mo Kio)
sentences.text: However, we must also consider the other 9.2% who do not own their homes.

sections.label: Fresh Start Housing Scheme support
sections.summary: Supports the Fresh Start Housing Scheme giving families with children in rental housing a second chance to own a home, suggesting a longer minimum occupation period.

sentences.speaker: Mr Gan Thiam Poh (Ang Mo Kio)
sentences.text: Not only would home ownership motivate them to stay in their jobs and work hard, it would also provide a stable environment for their children.

sentences.speaker: Mr Gan Thiam Poh (Ang Mo Kio)
sentences.text: Hence, I strongly support the new Fresh Start Housing Scheme which would provide families with children in rental housing a second chance to own a home.

sentences.speaker: Mr Gan Thiam Poh (Ang Mo Kio)
sentences.text: For instance, the minimum occupation period for families under this scheme could be longer.

sections.label: Fresh Start Scheme target families
sections.summary: States the Ministry's focus in the Fresh Start Housing Scheme is young families in public rental flats aspiring to become second-time home owners.

sentences.speaker: Miss Cheryl Chan Wei Ling (Fengshan)
sentences.text: In the Fresh Start Housing Scheme, the Ministry's focus is on young families who are currently living in public rental flats and aspire to become home owners as a second-time buyer.

sections.label: Considering more such requests
sections.summary: Asks whether the Ministry would consider the matter if there are more such requests.

sentences.speaker: Miss Cheryl Chan Wei Ling (Fengshan)
sentences.text: If there are more such requests, would the Ministry consider?

sections.label: CPF downpayment and mortgage loan period
sections.summary: It asks whether the scheme allows downpayment using CPF only and whether the maximum mortgage loan period can equal the full lease period.

sentences.speaker: Miss Cheryl Chan Wei Ling (Fengshan)
sentences.text: Does the scheme allow them to make the downpayment using CPF only, and can the maximum mortgage loan period for the flat be equivalent to the full lease period?

sections.label: Scheme for young married couples
sections.summary: It proposes extending the scheme to young married couples family planning or expecting a first child, with grants reduced to match income level.

sentences.speaker: Miss Cheryl Chan Wei Ling (Fengshan)
sentences.text: In addition, I propose that this scheme be also made available to young married couples who are in the process of family planning or soon to expect their first child.

sentences.speaker: Miss Cheryl Chan Wei Ling (Fengshan)
sentences.text: The grants made available could be reduced to match the income level, so as to maintain a fair treatment in financial assistance rendered.

sections.label: Shared spaces awareness and education
sections.summary: It asks the Ministry to prioritise basic awareness and education before infrastructure, and to step up measures against reckless behaviour in shared spaces.

sentences.speaker: Miss Cheryl Chan Wei Ling (Fengshan)
sentences.text: Unfortunately, the lack of thoughtfulness in shared spaces have resulted in one accident too many.

sentences.speaker: Miss Cheryl Chan Wei Ling (Fengshan)
sentences.text: Instead of pleasant, shared spaces, over time, what is sighted are increasing measures and enforcements that may not actually be enforceable over time, because we cannot counter these reckless behaviours.

sentences.speaker: Miss Cheryl Chan Wei Ling (Fengshan)
sentences.text: What I hope the Ministry could look into are: the basic awareness and education which should be the primary tasks before infrastructures are being put in place, can the Government prioritise this, and if so, step up on all these measures?

sections.label: MSF homeless assistance cases
sections.summary: MSF stated in a previous reply that it has rendered assistance to 300 homeless cases each year on average.

sentences.speaker: Mr Muhamad Faisal Bin Abdul Manap (Aljunied)
sentences.text: The Ministry of Social and Family Development (MSF), on its part, has stated in the previous reply to my Parliamentary Question that it has, on average, rendered assistance to 300 homeless cases each year.

sections.label: Flexible approach to 13-month rule
sections.summary: It urges MND to consider a more flexible and accommodative approach to the 13-month rule, with deliberations and discussions with affected families.

sentences.speaker: Mr Muhamad Faisal Bin Abdul Manap (Aljunied)
sentences.text: As such, I would like to urge the Ministry of National Development (MND) to consider a more flexible and accommodative approach to the implementation of the 13-month rule, with scope for greater deliberations and discussions with affected families.

sections.label: Elderly Subletting Facilitation Scheme proposal
sections.summary: It proposes an ESF Scheme where HDB connects elderly flat owners wanting to sublet rooms with tenants, possibly combined with the Public Rental Scheme.

sentences.speaker: Mr Muhamad Faisal Bin Abdul Manap (Aljunied)
sentences.text: As such, I would like to propose an Elderly Subletting Facilitation (ESF) Scheme where HDB connects elderly flat owners who would like to sublet rooms with potential tenants.

sentences.speaker: Mr Muhamad Faisal Bin Abdul Manap (Aljunied)
sentences.text: Furthermore, ESF could be combined synergistically with the Public Rental Scheme so that there is no need to turn away over 10,000 applicants to the Public Rental Scheme yearly.

sections.label: Buy back sold lease portion
sections.summary: Calls for LBS to let children of the deceased buy back the sold portion of the lease if they qualify to own an HDB flat.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chen Show Mao (Aljunied)
sentences.text: Today, I wish to reiterate an earlier call for LBS to be enhanced to give the children of the deceased the option to buy back the portion of the lease that has been sold, provided, of course, that they qualify to own an HDB flat.

sections.label: Fresh Start Housing Scheme grant
sections.summary: Says the Fresh Start Housing Scheme provides another housing grant to help families who sold a flat and now rent publicly.

sentences.speaker: Er Dr Lee Bee Wah (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: Some families may have previously owned a flat, but due to some difficulties, they sold it and ended up in public rental housing.

sentences.speaker: Er Dr Lee Bee Wah (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: I think for those who pick themselves up, work hard and are determined to give security to themselves and their family, the Fresh Start Housing Scheme, which provides another housing grant, will certainly make their dream of owning their home a reality.

sections.label: HDB rental flats and Fresh Start
sections.summary: Asks about plans to ramp up HDB rental flat supply, reduce waiting time, and how many families the Fresh Start Housing Scheme will benefit.

sentences.speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: What are the Ministry's plans to ramp up the supply of HDB rental flats and therefore reduce the waiting time for low-income families who are in urgent need of these flats?

sentences.speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: Also, with the launch of the Fresh Start Housing Scheme, how many families are expected to benefit from this scheme and be able to own their own flats finally?

sentences.speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: For example, by 2030, Singapore's Mass Rapid Transit (MRT) network will increase from 178 kilometres to 360 kilometres.

sections.label: More bicycle rental stations
sections.summary: Asks whether the Ministry will consider setting up more bicycle rental stations near homes, MRT stations, bus interchanges and workplaces.

sentences.speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: Will the Ministry consider the setting up of more bicycle rental stations near homes, MRT stations or bus interchanges and at various workplaces?

sections.label: Interim rental flats supply
sections.summary: Asks the Minister whether there are plans to ramp up the supply of interim rental flats and reduce waiting times.

sentences.speaker: Mr Saktiandi Supaat (Bishan-Toa Payoh)
sentences.text: Can the Minister share with the House if there are plans to ramp up the supply of interim rental flats and reduce waiting times?

sections.label: Priority help for employment
sections.summary: Asks whether some priority assistance will be provided to help genuine applicants seek employment.

sentences.speaker: Mr Saktiandi Supaat (Bishan-Toa Payoh)
sentences.text: Will some priority assistance be provided to help genuine applicants seek employment?

sections.label: Collaborative projects with other agencies
sections.summary: The passage asks whether the Ministry has such collaborative projects with other agencies in the pipeline.

sentences.speaker: Mr Saktiandi Supaat (Bishan-Toa Payoh)
sentences.text: Does the Ministry have such collaborative projects with other agencies in the pipeline?

sections.label: Plans for mature towns connectivity
sections.summary: The passage asks the Ministry to share its plans for enhancing mature towns to ensure better car-lite connectivity.

sentences.speaker: Mr Darryl David (Ang Mo Kio)
sentences.text: While mature towns would provide a different challenge, I would like to ask the Ministry if they could share what its plans are for enhancing mature towns to ensure better car-lite connectivity.

sections.label: EVs and charge points access
sections.summary: The passage asks the Minister what role EVs play in sustainability plans and whether charge point access will be facilitated in HDB estates and condominiums.

sentences.speaker: Mr Ong Teng Koon (Marsiling-Yew Tee)
sentences.text: On this point, I would like to ask the Minister what role EVs play in the Ministry's plans for a more sustainable living environment and whether the Ministry plans to facilitate access to EV charge points in existing HDB estates, as well as condominiums.

sections.label: Non-residents' large vehicles
sections.summary: The passage states that residents say these vehicles include large pickups, lorries and vans belonging to non-residents.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lim Biow Chuan (Mountbatten)
sentences.text: The residents tell me that these vehicles include large pickups, lorries and vans belonging to non-residents.

sections.label: Commercial vehicle parking disamenities
sections.summary: The passage describes parking disamenities from such vehicles and suggests owners park at URA car parks or sports stadiums.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lim Biow Chuan (Mountbatten)
sentences.text: The parking of such vehicles has caused disamenities to the residents as they are unable to find places for their own cars at night.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lim Biow Chuan (Mountbatten)
sentences.text: Often, these vehicles are parked in an indiscriminate manner, obstructing other road users.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lim Biow Chuan (Mountbatten)
sentences.text: In contrast, I do notice that there are places like URA car parks and sports stadiums which are heavily used during the day or during sporting events but are relatively less occupied in the late evenings or at night, depending on where these car parks are located.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lim Biow Chuan (Mountbatten)
sentences.text: We can find a win-win solution for the residents if we can persuade such vehicle owners that they can park their commercial vehicles at an URA car park or at a sports stadium, either free or with minimal charge.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lim Biow Chuan (Mountbatten)
sentences.text: The key objective is to try to ease the woes of residents who have total strangers parking their vehicles, including large commercial vehicles, just outside their own homes.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lim Biow Chuan (Mountbatten)
sentences.text: We need to think out of the box to better utilise scarce resources like parking lots which are not well used during off-peak hours.

sections.label: Housing sentiments after 2011
sections.summary: The passage states housing sentiments improved considerably after 2011 through ramped-up BTO supply, cleared first-timer backlog, more affordable flats and a soft market landing.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Lawrence Wong)
sentences.text: But in fact, sentiments on housing have improved considerably after 2011.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Lawrence Wong)
sentences.text: We ramped up the BTO supply and cleared the first-timer backlog.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Lawrence Wong)
sentences.text: We made new flats more affordable, and we have managed a soft landing in the property market and HDB resale prices.

sections.label: BTO prices for young couples
sections.summary: The pledge is that new BTO prices will always be kept stable and affordable for young Singaporean couples.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Lawrence Wong)
sentences.text: Our pledge to young Singaporean couples is that we will always keep new BTO prices stable and affordable for them.

sections.label: Bukit Batok 3-room flat booking
sections.summary: They booked a 3-room flat in Bukit Batok in last November's BTO exercise and were eligible for $60,000 in housing grants.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Lawrence Wong)
sentences.text: They booked a 3-room flat in Bukit Batok in the BTO exercise last November.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Lawrence Wong)
sentences.text: They were eligible for $60,000 in housing grants.

sections.label: Monitored indicator stayed stable
sections.summary: It is an indicator monitored very carefully, and it remained stable at about 1.6 last year.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Lawrence Wong)
sentences.text: It is an indicator which we monitor very carefully.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Lawrence Wong)
sentences.text: This has remained stable at about 1.6 last year.

sections.label: Resale prices, income and housing grants
sections.summary: From 2009 to 2015 HDB resale prices rose 35% while median household income rose 44%, and the Proximity Housing Grant lets a young couple enjoy up to $90,000 in grants for a resale flat.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Lawrence Wong)
sentences.text: Between the last property market troughs in 2009 and 2015, HDB resale prices increased by 35% but median household income increased by a higher 44%.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Lawrence Wong)
sentences.text: In addition, we introduced the Proximity Housing Grant (PHG) which helps families who wish to live near or with their parents or married child to buy a resale flat.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Lawrence Wong)
sentences.text: This means that a young couple can enjoy up to $90,000 in housing grants to buy their first home from the resale market – $30,000 in the CPF Housing Grant, up to $40,000 in Additional CPF Housing Grant, and $20,000 in the Proximity Housing Grant.

sections.label: Bukit Batok resale flat near parents
sections.summary: They found a 4-room resale flat in Bukit Batok on the same floor as her parents, and with the Proximity Grant bought it for about $324,000.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Lawrence Wong)
sentences.text: They looked at several housing options and, eventually, they managed to find a 4-room resale flat in Bukit Batok on the same floor, just down the corridor from her parents' place.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Lawrence Wong)
sentences.text: So, with the Proximity Grant, they were able to buy the resale flat for about $324,000.

sections.label: 2-room flats and singles quota
sections.summary: More 2-room flats were launched for singles and the singles quota was raised from 30% to 50% last year.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Lawrence Wong)
sentences.text: Er Dr Lee Bee Wah asked about this and I would like to assure her that we have launched more 2-room flats to meet this new demand from singles.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Lawrence Wong)
sentences.text: We also increased the quota for singles from 30% to 50% last year.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Lawrence Wong)
sentences.text: It started out very high, over 30 when we made the move in 2013.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Lawrence Wong)
sentences.text: It came down to 8.5 last year, and it was 7.7 in the most recent BTO exercise.

sections.label: BTO and resale flat prices
sections.summary: Buying a new BTO or resale flat requires financial prudence, with 3-room flats ranging from $180,000 in Bukit Batok to $368,000 in Queenstown.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Lawrence Wong)
sentences.text: At the same time, whether buying a new BTO flat or a resale flat, there is a need to be financially prudent.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Lawrence Wong)
sentences.text: We have homes for every budget – 3-room flat can vary from $180,000 for a BTO in Bukit Batok to $368,000 for a resale flat in Queenstown.

sections.label: Tapering new flat building programme
sections.summary: This year 18,000 new flats are being built, but the building programme will gradually taper down to a more sustainable level over the medium term.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Lawrence Wong)
sentences.text: And that balance includes looking at resale and new flats.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Lawrence Wong)
sentences.text: This year, we are building 18,000 new flats.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Lawrence Wong)
sentences.text: But we cannot continue at this rate perpetually.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Lawrence Wong)
sentences.text: We intend to gradually taper down our building programme to achieve a more sustainable level over the medium term.

sections.label: Fresh Start Housing Scheme introduction
sections.summary: Second-timer families in rental flats are no longer eligible for housing grants and likely cannot get bank loans, so the Fresh Start Housing Scheme is introduced.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Lawrence Wong)
sentences.text: For many of them, second-timer families in the rental flats, they are no longer eligible for housing grants; they are probably unable to get a bank loan and so they will face greater difficulties in moving out of their rental situation to have a home of their own.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Lawrence Wong)
sentences.text: That is why we are introducing the Fresh Start Housing Scheme.

sections.label: Fresh Start Housing Grant amount
sections.summary: A Fresh Start Housing Grant of up to $35,000 will help these families.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Lawrence Wong)
sentences.text: Third, we will help them with a Fresh Start Housing Grant of up to $35,000.

sections.label: Grant disbursement and MSF support
sections.summary: The grant is disbursed in tranches: $20,000 at key collection and the remainder annually over five years, with MSF officers checking in and linking families to social support.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Lawrence Wong)
sentences.text: In line with the efforts they make, the grant will correspondingly be disbursed in tranches over time: $20,000 will be given out when they collect their keys, and the remainder will be disbursed annually over the next five years.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Lawrence Wong)
sentences.text: Mr Saktiandi Supaat expressed some concerns about the conditions attached to the grants.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Lawrence Wong)
sentences.text: I am very mindful that these conditions should not be onerous.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Lawrence Wong)
sentences.text: But at the same time, we are making a major move for these families by giving them another grant.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Lawrence Wong)
sentences.text: So, it is fair that they must be able to show a certain level of commitment towards homeownership.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Lawrence Wong)
sentences.text: We will be working with MSF on this.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Lawrence Wong)
sentences.text: So, MSF officers will check in with the families regularly to ensure that they are doing well and they will link them up with partners for social support where needed.

sections.label: Case-by-case judgement and discretion
sections.summary: A single matrix or criterion will not be relied on; judgement and discretion will be exercised case by case.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Lawrence Wong)
sentences.text: In doing so, we will not rely on just a single matrix or single criterion because we will exercise judgement and discretion and will look at it case by case.

sections.label: Fresh Start 2-room flat
sections.summary: Under Fresh Start, buyers can buy a new 2-room flat with a 60-year lease and pay about $300 monthly.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lawrence Wong
sentences.text: With Fresh Start, they will be able to buy a new 2-room flat with a 60-year lease.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lawrence Wong
sentences.text: They will have a monthly instalment of about $300.

sections.label: Fresh Start scheme implementation details
sections.summary: Most payment comes from CPF with $10 monthly cash outlay, and the scheme targets about 1,000 second-timer rental households.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lawrence Wong
sentences.text: If you look at the illustration, the bulk of it will now be paid through CPF and their cash outlay is $10 a month.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lawrence Wong
sentences.text: It is a comparable amount that they have to pay overall, but a large part of it is paid through CPF now and they would be able to own their own flat eventually.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lawrence Wong
sentences.text: We plan to implement the scheme by the end of this year.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lawrence Wong
sentences.text: If you look at the profile of those living in rental flats today – those who are second timers, with school-going children, based on the demographic profile that we are aiming for and who do not have excessive rental arrears with HDB presently – the estimate is that this group is about 1,000.

sections.label: New Tengah HDB town
sections.summary: A new HDB town called Tengah will open and be planned as a Forest Town.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lawrence Wong
sentences.text: Soon, we will be opening up a new HDB town called Tengah.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lawrence Wong
sentences.text: Members have seen the slides and the video that Minister Heng Swee Keat showed on the Jurong Innovation District.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lawrence Wong
sentences.text: We will plan this as a "Forest Town".

sections.label: New requirement for developers
sections.summary: LTA and URA will introduce a new requirement for developers to bolster these efforts.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lawrence Wong
sentences.text: To further bolster these efforts, the Land Transport Authority (LTA) and URA will be introducing a new requirement for developers.

sections.label: Bedok cycling and walking network
sections.summary: In Bedok Town, a comprehensive cycling and walking network of about 14 km will be completed next year.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lawrence Wong
sentences.text: Here is one example in Bedok Town, which I will show on the slide, where a comprehensive cycling and walking network of approximately 14 km will be completed next year.

sections.label: Six cycling routes to city
sections.summary: Six possible cycling routes to the city were identified for towns within a 30-minute cycling distance.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lawrence Wong
sentences.text: For a start, we are looking at towns that are within a 30-minute cycling distance to the city.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lawrence Wong
sentences.text: So, we have identified six possible routes to the city, as shown in the map.

sections.label: Gaps in cycling routes
sections.summary: The routes have gaps that the speaker intends to plug so they can be seamless and better connect HDB towns to the city centre.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lawrence Wong
sentences.text: If you actually travel or take a cycling ride through one of these routes, you will realise that they are not fully seamless and there are some gaps along the way.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lawrence Wong
sentences.text: We intend to plug these gaps, so that the routes can be seamless, and they can better connect our HDB towns to the city centre.

sections.label: URA consultancy study on gaps
sections.summary: URA has initiated a consultancy study to look at possible solutions to bridge the gaps.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lawrence Wong
sentences.text: URA has initiated a consultancy study to look at possible solutions to bridge these gaps.

sections.label: URA major exhibition
sections.summary: URA will hold a major exhibition later this year.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lawrence Wong
sentences.text: URA will hold a major exhibition later this year.

sections.label: Raising car park charges
sections.summary: The speaker says car park charges may have to be raised, rather than lowered or made free, to move towards a car-lite city.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lawrence Wong
sentences.text: Perhaps, we should not be thinking about lowering car park charges or making them free, but we may even have to look at raising car park charges if we want to move in the direction of a car-lite city.

sections.label: City centre pedestrian streets
sections.summary: In the city centre, 18 streets are closed for pedestrians to use on a regular basis, such as during weekends.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lawrence Wong
sentences.text: Currently, if you look at our city centre, there are 18 streets which are closed for pedestrians to use on a regular basis, such as during weekends.

sections.label: Our Favourite Place programme
sections.summary: URA will enhance an existing programme called "Our Favourite Place" to invite Singaporeans to help shape public spaces, with regulatory help and seed funding.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lawrence Wong
sentences.text: URA has an existing programme which they will enhance and will call it, "Our Favourite Place", to invite Singaporeans to collaborate and play a greater role in shaping the use of our public spaces.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lawrence Wong
sentences.text: Through this programme, we will support individuals or groups who have ideas and are keen to activate public spaces.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lawrence Wong
sentences.text: We will assist them to streamline regulatory approvals from Government agencies and we will provide seed funding to get the ideas implemented on the ground.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lawrence Wong
sentences.text: I hope that, in time, a network of like-minded volunteers and civic partners will grow through this programme.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lawrence Wong
sentences.text: This will help us catalyse a broader movement to get Singaporeans involved in shaping our streets and public spaces.

sections.label: MSO response time and OneService app
sections.summary: Response time fell from eight to six and a half days, and the OneService app has close to 40,000 downloads, which is low.

sentences.speaker: Mr Alex Yam
sentences.text: Though the response time has come down from eight to six and a half days, would MSO be setting a target for even better response time for the next one year?

sentences.speaker: Mr Alex Yam
sentences.text: The OneService mobile app has been downloaded currently by close to 40,000 users, which is low.

sections.label: OneService app usage rate
sections.summary: The passage asks about the OneService app's usage rate and how much it facilitated timely responses to problems raised with agencies.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chong Kee Hiong
sentences.text: What has been the usage rate of OneService app and how much has it facilitated the timely response to the problems brought to the attention of the agencies?

sections.label: MSO effectiveness and technology plans
sections.summary: The passage asks how MSO will respond to municipal issues with Town Councils and leverage technology given manpower constraints.

sentences.speaker: Mr Ong Teng Koon
sentences.text: Moving beyond the issue of gathering feedback more effectively, the real test of the MSO's effectiveness will be in its ability to respond to and resolve municipal issues in a timely fashion, in collaboration with existing agencies, such as local Town Councils.

sentences.speaker: Mr Ong Teng Koon
sentences.text: This has started in a modest way, with a pilot involving two Town Councils.

sentences.speaker: Mr Ong Teng Koon
sentences.text: Last but not least, given the existing manpower constraints in Singapore, what plans does the MSO have to seek to leverage technology to raise the productivity of municipal service delivery?

sections.label: MSO Town Council collaboration pilot
sections.summary: MSO piloted with Jurong and Holland-Bukit Panjang Town Councils and is ready to extend collaboration to other Town Councils.

sentences.speaker: Mr Baey Yam Keng (Tampines)
sentences.text: Some of these fall under the public agencies' purview and we have to redirect to the agencies accordingly.

sentences.speaker: Mr Baey Yam Keng (Tampines)
sentences.text: Therefore, as the Chairman of Tampines Town Council, I am glad to hear that MSO started a pilot with Jurong and Holland-Bukit Panjang Town Councils last year to finetune feedback management protocols and to better channel feedback cases to the right agency for follow-up.

sentences.speaker: Mr Baey Yam Keng (Tampines)
sentences.text: Minister Grace Fu also indicated in March on her Facebook post that MSO is now ready to extend the collaboration to other Town Councils.

sentences.speaker: Mr Baey Yam Keng (Tampines)
sentences.text: How many Town Councils will be partnering MSO and when can we expect to come onboard?

sentences.speaker: Mr Baey Yam Keng (Tampines)
sentences.text: Besides improving feedback management, are there other initiatives under this collaboration with the Town Councils?

sentences.speaker: Mr Baey Yam Keng (Tampines)
sentences.text: Can MSO also look at matters under private companies providing public services, for example Singapore Power and telecommunications companies?

sections.label: Resident satisfaction with municipal services
sections.summary: In a recent survey, 77% of residents said they are satisfied with municipal services in their neighbourhoods.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
sentences.text: In our recent survey, 77% of residents indicated that they are satisfied with municipal services in their neighbourhoods.

sections.label: Complex case closure time reduced
sections.summary: Average time to close complex multi-agency cases fell by about eight days over the past year, from 21 to 13 days.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
sentences.text: Complex cases like this are inevitable and invariably take longer to resolve.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
sentences.text: But through systematic culling of issues, one by one, ascertaining responsibility, facilitating coordination, we have reduced the average time taken to close such complex cases that require multiple agencies to work together by about eight days over the past year, from 21 to 13 days.

sections.label: OneService app pothole report
sections.summary: A resident used the OneService app to report a pothole, and digital feedback channels rose four-fold in a year.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
sentences.text: In February this year, Mr Darren Siow used the OneService app to report on a pothole along Thomson Road, without having to identify the owner of the problem, and this is what he said, "The efficient OneService ecosystem of receiving reports, assigning cases to the relevant agency and the resolution of issues is indeed praiseworthy." Indeed, digital channels, such as mobile apps and web portals, make it easier for the public to provide feedback and speed up our response process.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
sentences.text: There has been a four-fold increase in the proportion of municipal feedback received via digital channels over the past year, from about 3% – a low base – to 12%.

sections.label: Spot Abandoned Trolleys initiative
sections.summary: MSO is working with five supermarket chains on an initiative called Spot Abandoned Trolleys.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
sentences.text: To address such problems, MSO is working with five supermarket chains on an initiative called "Spot Abandoned Trolleys".

sections.label: NParks takes over greenery maintenance
sections.summary: From June this year, NParks will take over other forms of greenery maintenance from HDB, SLA and PUB.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
sentences.text: From June this year, NParks will be taking over other forms of greenery maintenance from HDB, SLA and PUB.

sections.label: Town Council feedback pilot success
sections.summary: MSO piloted aligning feedback management with Jurong-Clementi and Holland-Bukit Panjang Town Councils, and the pilot succeeded.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
sentences.text: It is not enough for MSO to work with just the Government agencies, as more than 80% of Singaporeans live in HDB estates which are managed by Town Councils.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
sentences.text: We started a pilot with Jurong-Clementi and Holland-Bukit Panjang Town Councils last year to align the feedback management process between Town Councils and agencies.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
sentences.text: To answer Mr Ong Teng Koon and Mr Baey Yam Keng, the pilot was a success.

sections.label: All 16 Town Councils onboard
sections.summary: All 16 Town Councils agreed to participate, and will be brought onboard progressively by the fourth quarter of this year.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
sentences.text: A number of Members asked about our plans, following the pilot.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
sentences.text: I am glad to update that we have invited all 16 Town Councils to participate, and they have all agreed to come onboard.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
sentences.text: Each Town Council has its unique processes and systems, and we will need time to work with each of them to ease the transition.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
sentences.text: We will progressively bring the Town Councils onboard from now to the fourth quarter of this year.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
sentences.text: This means that by the end of the year, residents across the island will be able to benefit from the closer coordination between Town Councils and Government agencies.

sections.label: Community partnership in municipal services
sections.summary: The Government does not regulate private businesses but will work with partners, and residents have a role in municipal services.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
sentences.text: While the Government does not regulate the operations and feedback management processes of private businesses, we are prepared to work closely with them and all relevant partners, to improve our common spaces.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
sentences.text: In line with the call for Partnering for the Future, MSO will enable greater community partnership in municipal services.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
sentences.text: Residents have an important role to play by alerting us to issues in your neighbourhood, by being an active and engaged resident and by participating in community building.

sections.label: Construction Productivity Roadmap progress update
sections.summary: The second Construction Productivity Roadmap was rolled out last year and an update on its progress is sought.

sentences.speaker: Er Dr Lee Bee Wah
sentences.text: Last year, the second Construction Productivity Roadmap was rolled out.

sentences.speaker: Er Dr Lee Bee Wah
sentences.text: Can the Minister give an update on its progress?

sections.label: Absorbing PPVC cost difference
sections.summary: The Government is asked whether it will consider absorbing the PPVC cost difference during this initial period, said to cost up to 40% more.

sentences.speaker: Er Dr Lee Bee Wah
sentences.text: Will the Government consider absorbing the difference in the cost of PPVC during this initial period which, I am told, can cost up to 40% more?

sections.label: Land sales terms raise costs
sections.summary: Land sales terms and conditions have increased development risks and construction costs correspondingly.

sentences.speaker: Dr Teo Ho Pin (Bukit Panjang)
sentences.text: The land sales' terms and conditions such as project completion period, extension premium scheme, use of Prefabricated Prefinished Volumetric Construction (PPVC) method and the need to sell all dwelling units in a housing development within two years from the temporary occupation permit (TOP), have increased development risks and construction costs correspondingly.

sections.label: NUS building degree recognition
sections.summary: The NUS building course was repackaged to attract applications as the building degree is not recognised by Singapore authorities.

sentences.speaker: Dr Teo Ho Pin (Bukit Panjang)
sentences.text: In fact, the building course in the National University of Singapore (NUS) had to be repackaged in order to attract applications as the building degree is not recognised by the authorities in Singapore.

sentences.speaker: Dr Teo Ho Pin (Bukit Panjang)
sentences.text: I urge the Ministry to take immediate action to build a core team of building professionals in Singapore.

sections.label: Aljunied-Hougang lift breakdown figures
sections.summary: Aljunied-Hougang Town Council manages 1,760 HDB estate lifts, with 3,683 breakdowns in FY2015/2016, averaging 7.84 per lift.

sentences.speaker: Mr Low Thia Khiang (Aljunied)
sentences.text: The Aljunied-Hougang Town Council currently manages 1,760 lifts in HDB estates, out of which 470 are new lifts installed under the Lift Upgrading Programme (LUP) being turned on from 2012 onwards.

sentences.speaker: Mr Low Thia Khiang (Aljunied)
sentences.text: Based on the figures gathered for lift breakdown in financial year (FY) 2015/2016, there were 3,683 breakdowns in total, or 7.84 breakdowns per lift on average.

sections.label: Special grant for lift maintenance
sections.summary: Lift maintenance contract revisions will raise costs, and MND is requested to consider a special grant for lift maintenance.

sentences.speaker: Mr Low Thia Khiang (Aljunied)
sentences.text: In the case of Aljunied-Hougang Town Council, the latest revision in maintenance contracts by the original lift manufacturers will result in a cost increase of between 4.08% and 8.52%.

sentences.speaker: Mr Low Thia Khiang (Aljunied)
sentences.text: The projected upward revision in maintenance rates beyond 2017 is even higher, estimated to be between 8.66% and 10.72%.

sentences.speaker: Mr Low Thia Khiang (Aljunied)
sentences.text: I believe that moving forward, lift maintenance will be a heavy financial burden on all the Town Councils.

sentences.speaker: Mr Low Thia Khiang (Aljunied)
sentences.text: Hence, I request MND to consider providing a special grant for lift maintenance.

sections.label: Ceiling leak repair cost sharing
sections.summary: The remaining 50% of repair cost is shared equally by upper and lower floor flat owners for ceiling leaks from wear and tear.

sentences.speaker: Mr Muhamad Faisal Bin Abdul Manap
sentences.text: The balance 50% is shared equally by the upper and lower floor flat owners who share the joint responsibility for the repair of ceiling leaks due to wear and tear.

sections.label: Billing for upper floor leak
sections.summary: Only the upper floor leak source is rectified, and after works both flat owners are each billed 25% of total repair cost.

sentences.speaker: Mr Muhamad Faisal Bin Abdul Manap
sentences.text: Only the source of the leak located at the upper floor would be rectified, but upon the completion of the repair works, both flat owners, the upper floor as well as the lower floor, will each be billed 25% of the total repair cost.

sections.label: Sembawang Hot Spring Park proposal
sections.summary: A national treasure unknown to many Singaporeans, with an appeal to redevelop the area into Sembawang Hot Spring Park managed by NParks.

sentences.speaker: Dr Lim Wee Kiak (Sembawang)
sentences.text: It is a national treasure that is sadly unknown to many Singaporeans.

sentences.speaker: Dr Lim Wee Kiak (Sembawang)
sentences.text: I appeal to the Government to redevelop the area now into our national Sembawang Hot Spring Park to be managed by NParks.

sections.label: Rail Corridor tender award features
sections.summary: The tender award features eight themed stretches along the 24-kilometre Rail Corridor and 10 community nodes with differentiated experiences.

sentences.speaker: Ms Low Yen Ling (Chua Chu Kang)
sentences.text: The award of tender for proposals features eight distinctively themed stretches along the 24-kilometre-long Rail Corridor and 10 community nodes offering differentiated experiences.

sections.label: Choa Chu Kang housing test bed
sections.summary: A 16-hectare Choa Chu Kang site along the former KTM railway line will test a future housing concept hosting 3,000 units.

sentences.speaker: Ms Low Yen Ling (Chua Chu Kang)
sentences.text: Under the Railway Corridor development, a 16-hectare site in Choa Chu Kang that falls along the stretch of the former 30-metre Keretapi Tanah Melayu (KTM) railway line will be the test bed for a future housing concept hosting 3,000 units.

sections.label: Operators hesitant on enhanced ROS
sections.summary: Operators hesitate on the enhanced ROS scheme as investment does not justify remaining lease, so Government should consider lease extension options.

sentences.speaker: Miss Cheryl Chan Wei Ling
sentences.text: The operators are hesitant to participate in the enhanced Revitalisation of Shops (ROS) scheme as the amount they have to invest, albeit co-funded, does not justify the remaining lease period.

sentences.speaker: Miss Cheryl Chan Wei Ling
sentences.text: The Government should, therefore, consider giving these owner-operators an option to extend their leases so that the cost-benefit of the enhanced ROS scheme is more attractive to them.

sections.label: Revitalisation of Shop scheme
sections.summary: The Revitalisation of Shop scheme needs to be revitalised because it has suffered from a low take-up rate.

sentences.speaker: Mr Ang Wei Neng
sentences.text: The Revitalisation of Shop (ROS) scheme needs to be revitalised as it has suffered from a low take-up rate.

sections.label: Amending law for merchant associations
sections.summary: A suggestion to amend the law so merchant associations need support from 75% of shop owners for upgrading to proceed.

sentences.speaker: Mr Ang Wei Neng
sentences.text: Perhaps we can consider amending the law, so that merchant associations only need to obtain support from 75% of shop owners for the upgrading to proceed.

sections.label: Doubling grant for merchants associations
sections.summary: A hope that the Minister can help merchants associations by doubling the grant to S$20,000 per shop.

sentences.speaker: Mr Ang Wei Neng
sentences.text: Since the Government is committed to helping revitalise neighbourhood shops, I hope the Minister can help merchants associations by doubling the grant to S$20,000 per shop.

sections.label: Estate Upgrading Programme necessity
sections.summary: The Estate Upgrading Programme is necessary to prevent shared public areas from degenerating into safety and health hazards.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chong Kee Hiong
sentences.text: The Estate Upgrading Programme (EUP) is necessary to prevent many of the shared public areas from degenerating into safety and health hazards.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chong Kee Hiong
sentences.text: Fences or railings to separate pavements from open drains will be helpful to prevent falls into the drains.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chong Kee Hiong
sentences.text: Old footpaths and open drains may be pitted and become breeding grounds for mosquitoes after the rain.

sections.label: Speeding up urgent estate repairs
sections.summary: A question on whether areas needing urgent safety repairs can be sped up under a special fund or programme.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chong Kee Hiong
sentences.text: In the event that EUP could not be sped up, the waiting time for upgrade for these old estates could take several years.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chong Kee Hiong
sentences.text: Can areas that need urgent repairs for safety reasons such as covering up of open drains to create wider footpaths be sped up under a special fund or programme?

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: First, working with the community to rejuvenate and transform our heartlands; second, enhancing greenery in our City in a Garden; and third, partnering the construction industry to transform the way we build our city.

sections.label: Adjusting ROS co-funding and startup funding
sections.summary: For ROS upgrading works, the co-funding ratio will be adjusted and startup funding will support new merchants associations.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: First, for upgrading works under ROS, we will adjust the co-funding ratio among the Government, the HDB shopkeepers and the Town Councils.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: What this means is that our shopkeepers pay less, while the Government and Town Councils pay more.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: Second, we will provide some startup funding to support the formation of new merchants associations.

sections.label: Support for HDB heartland shops
sections.summary: The government is collaborating with MTI and SPRING to explore other areas of support for local HDB heartland shops and is studying whether to require polling for ROS upgrading.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: So, for instance, we are collaborating with the Ministry of Trade and Industry (MTI) and SPRING to explore other areas of support for our local HDB heartland shops.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: We are also studying very carefully whether to introduce a requirement for polling for ROS upgrading.

sections.label: Polling requirement for ROS upgrading
sections.summary: The government is looking carefully at whether to make legislative amendments to make polling a requirement for ROS upgrading.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: Therefore, while they understand that it could benefit other retailers and residents, they were less inclined to support the programme.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: So, we are looking carefully at whether we should make legislative amendments to make polling a requirement.

sections.label: HDB partnership for young entrepreneurs
sections.summary: HDB is partnering MTI and SPRING Singapore to tap current schemes to better support young entrepreneurs.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: HDB is also partnering MTI and SPRING Singapore to tap current schemes to better support these young entrepreneurs.

sections.label: NParks launching more gardens
sections.summary: NParks will launch eight more in the next few years.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: NParks will launch eight more in the next few years.

sections.label: Therapeutic gardens for seniors
sections.summary: Seniors and their caregivers can look forward to an upcoming network of therapeutic gardens with contemplative spaces and activity zones to support dementia and post-stroke patients.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: Seniors and their caregivers can look forward to an upcoming network of therapeutic gardens, with contemplative spaces and activity zones, to support dementia and post-stroke patients.

sections.label: Refining Rail Corridor plans
sections.summary: With localised feedback, URA and the designers will review and refine current plans to make the Rail Corridor an inclusive green space, with the community as active stewards.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: With such localised feedback, URA and the designers will review and refine our current plans to make the Rail Corridor an inclusive green space, with the community as active stewards.

sections.label: Site productivity growth
sections.summary: Site productivity has risen an average of 1.3% per year since 2009, with 2% annual improvement in the last two years.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: Site productivity, or the amount of floor area completed per man-day, has steadily increased by an average of 1.3% per year since 2009.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: In fact, for the last two years, we saw a 2% annual improvement.

sections.label: Construction Productivity and Capability Fund
sections.summary: The Construction Productivity and Capability Fund has set aside $885 million over two tranches, and over 8,000 firms have tapped it.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: First, we have set up the Construction Productivity and Capability Fund (CPCF), and set aside a total of $885 million, over two tranches, to help firms raise their capability in the immediate term.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: Today, over 8,000 firms have already tapped on this fund to either invest in more productive technologies, mechanise their processes or up-skill their workforce.

sections.label: Students and jobseekers brought in
sections.summary: More than 2,000 students and jobseekers have been brought in through these programmes since 2010.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: More than 2,000 students and jobseekers have been brought in through these programmes since 2010.

sections.label: SCDF relaxed CLT height requirements
sections.summary: SCDF has relaxed height requirements for the majority of CLT building-use types from 12 metres to 24 metres.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: For example, SCDF has relaxed height requirements for the majority of CLT building-use types from 12 metres to 24 metres.

sections.label: Construction Productivity R&D Roadmap
sections.summary: A Construction Productivity R&D Roadmap is being developed with industry players and will be launched in the second half of this year.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: A Construction Productivity R&D Roadmap is currently being developed together with industry players and will be launched in the second half of this year.

sections.label: Sinking fund and lift replacement
sections.summary: MND is considering ring-fencing part of Town Councils' sinking fund, and in September 2014 HDB rolled out the Selective Lift Replacement Programme.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: MND is also considering ring-fencing part of the Town Councils' sinking fund to cater for such expenditure.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: For instance, in September 2014, HDB rolled out the Selective Lift Replacement Programme to help Town Councils replace older lifts that lack key features, such as energy-efficient motors, infra-red door safety sensors and vision panels, found in more modern lifts.

sections.label: Pneumatic Waste Conveyance System expansion
sections.summary: The Pneumatic Waste Conveyance System will be extended to new BTO developments where viable, including Tampines North and Punggol Northshore.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: Mr Low Thia Khiang asked specifically if the Pneumatic Waste Conveyance System will be extended to all suitable HDB estates.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: We plan to do so in new BTO developments where viable, including in Tampines North and Punggol Northshore.

sections.label: Agriculture Productivity Fund utilisation
sections.summary: The $63 million Agriculture Productivity Fund was set up at the end of 2014, but only slightly above 1% has been utilised.

sentences.speaker: Mr Alex Yam
sentences.text: The $63 million Agriculture Productivity Fund (APF) was set up at the end of 2014 and helps farmers to boost yields and raise their general productivity.

sentences.speaker: Mr Alex Yam
sentences.text: Yet, to the best of my knowledge, only slightly above 1% of the funds have been utilised till date.

sentences.speaker: Mr Alex Yam
sentences.text: The previous 2009 to 2014 Food Fund also saw only 60% of the $30 million set aside utilised.

sections.label: Stray animal populations and euthanasia
sections.summary: Estimated populations are about 7,000 stray dogs, 60,000 stray cats and 1,900 wild monkeys, and AVA euthanised 942 dogs, 888 cats and 623 monkeys last year.

sentences.speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang
sentences.text: The current estimated populations of stray dogs, stray cats and wild monkeys are about 7,000, 60,000 and 1,900 respectively.

sentences.speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang
sentences.text: Last year, AVA euthanised 942 dogs, 888 cats and 623 monkeys in an effort to manage the populations of these animals or in response to public feedback.

sections.label: Rental flat supply and waiting time
sections.summary: Rental supply rose from 42,000 in 2007 to 53,500 now and will reach 60,000 in 2017, cutting waiting time from 21 months in 2008 to four months today.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for National Development (Dr Koh Poh Koon)
sentences.text: A few Members asked about our supply of rental flats.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for National Development (Dr Koh Poh Koon)
sentences.text: We have ramped up the rental supply from 42,000 in 2007 to 53,500 now, and it will go up to 60,000 in 2017.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for National Development (Dr Koh Poh Koon)
sentences.text: As a result, the waiting time for a rental flat has been reduced significantly from 21 months in 2008 to four months today.

sections.label: TPS flats for first-timer rental families
sections.summary: The scheme has been open to first-timer rental families, and in 2015 411 2-room flats were set aside under TPS.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for National Development (Dr Koh Poh Koon)
sentences.text: The scheme has been open to first-timer rental families.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for National Development (Dr Koh Poh Koon)
sentences.text: So, in 2015, we set aside 411 2-room flats under TPS.

sections.label: TPS extension to second-timer rental families
sections.summary: From HDB's next sales exercise, second-timer rental families can benefit from the 10% TPS quota if they have stayed at least two years in a rental flat.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for National Development (Dr Koh Poh Koon)
sentences.text: Therefore, extending TPS to these second timer families will increase their chances of selecting a flat and moving on to home ownership.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for National Development (Dr Koh Poh Koon)
sentences.text: So, from HDB's next sales exercise, second-timer rental families can also benefit from the 10% quota of flats set aside under TPS.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for National Development (Dr Koh Poh Koon)
sentences.text: Like their first-timer counterparts, they will be eligible if they have stayed for at least two years in a rental flat and are applying for a 2- or 3-room home ownership flat.

sections.label: Lease Buyback Scheme enhancements
sections.summary: LBS was enhanced in April last year in four ways, and 500 households have taken it up since, up from an average of 160 per year before.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for National Development (Dr Koh Poh Koon)
sentences.text: Mr Chen Show Mao and Mr Alex Yam asked about the Lease Buyback Scheme (LBS).

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for National Development (Dr Koh Poh Koon)
sentences.text: We enhanced LBS in April last year in a few ways: (a) we extended it to 4-room flats, which is the most common HDB flat type today; (b) we increased the income ceiling from $3,000 to $12,000; (c) we relaxed the CPF top-up required for households with multiple owners; and (d) we gave households a wider choice of how much lease they wish to retain.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for National Development (Dr Koh Poh Koon)
sentences.text: Five hundred households have taken up LBS since it was enhanced about a year ago.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for National Development (Dr Koh Poh Koon)
sentences.text: This is a significant increase from the average of 160 per year prior to the enhancements.

sections.label: Sterilising stray cats
sections.summary: With this expansion, 20,000 more stray cats are to be sterilised.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for National Development (Dr Koh Poh Koon)
sentences.text: With this expansion, we hope to sterilise 20,000 more stray cats.

sections.label: Wildlife trafficking cases decline
sections.summary: Wildlife trafficking cases fell from 23 in 2011 to 12 in 2015.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for National Development (Dr Koh Poh Koon)
sentences.text: Through these efforts, the number of wildlife trafficking cases has decreased from 23 in 2011 to 12 in 2015.

sections.label: Local food production and agriculture policies
sections.summary: Singapore is reviewing agriculture policies, including lease tenure, to raise local food production and become a living lab for food production technologies.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for National Development (Dr Koh Poh Koon)
sentences.text: Developing countries are also seeing their young people migrate to the cities, leaving less manpower for farming.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for National Development (Dr Koh Poh Koon)
sentences.text: So, there is no certainty that the global food supply will keep up with the growing global demand.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for National Development (Dr Koh Poh Koon)
sentences.text: We need to raise our local food production to buffer against such uncertainties in the future.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for National Development (Dr Koh Poh Koon)
sentences.text: Singapore can carve a niche in urban solutions by becoming a living lab for food production technologies, just like what we have done for water recycling and desalination, turning a disadvantage into something we can be proud of.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for National Development (Dr Koh Poh Koon)
sentences.text: To facilitate that and hearing our farmers' feedback, we are reviewing our agriculture policies, including the lease tenure, to give farmers impetus to invest in transformative technologies.

sections.label: Farm production volumes and comparisons
sections.summary: In 2015 farms produced about 5,300 tonnes of fish, 11,400 tonnes of leafy vegetables and 421 million eggs, with volumes up over five years.

sentences.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
sentences.text: In 2015, our farms produced about 5,300 tonnes of fish for food, 11,400 tonnes of leafy vegetables and 421 million eggs.

sentences.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
sentences.text: Compared to five years ago, production volumes have gone up by 52% for fish, 21% for vegetables and 10% for eggs respectively.

sentences.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
sentences.text: The Netherlands and Denmark employ technologies that are five to six times more productive than our most productive fish farms, and two times more productive than our best vegetable farms.

sections.label: Rationale for 20-year MOP
sections.summary: A question asks the Minister to explain the rationale for deciding the MOP as 20 years.

sentences.speaker: Mr Alex Yam
sentences.text: Could the Minister explain the rationale behind deciding the MOP as 20 years?

sections.label: Lift procurement in housing estates
sections.summary: Lift selection for housing estates, including LUP, uses a price-quality procurement process considering both price and lift quality.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: In deciding what lifts are put into a housing estate, including in LUP, we process projects by way of a price-quality procurement process where you look not just at price, but also the quality of the lift.

sections.label: Lift brands and maintenance players
sections.summary: HDB estates use at least 20 lift brands, with many maintenance players including original manufacturers and third-party contractors.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: In HDB estates across Singapore, there are easily at least 20 brands of lifts being used.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: Equally, many players in the lift maintenance market, including the original lift manufacturers and third-party contractors.

sections.label: HDB competitive lift market
sections.summary: HDB upholds a competitive market and will not allow any party to abuse market power in parts or maintenance.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: HDB upholds a competitive market and will not allow any particular party to abuse its market power, whether it is a part, or whether it is a maintenance regime.

sections.label: Government pays half leakage cost
sections.summary: Lower-floor residents suffer the leakage, and the scheme encourages both parties to solve it, with HDB paying half the fixing cost.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: In this particular instance, it will be the residents of the lower floor who are suffering from the leakage and, therefore, the scheme encourages both parties to do what is necessary to solve the problem.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: So, the Government, HDB will pay half the cost of fixing the leakage.

sections.label: Two to three years to clear demand
sections.summary: Based on that level, clearing that level of demand will take two to three years.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lawrence Wong
sentences.text: Based on that level, I think we will take two to three years to clear that level of demand.

sections.label: Child of school-going age
sections.summary: At least one child, meaning school-going age, which is anything less than 16 years old.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lawrence Wong
sentences.text: At least one child, so that means school-going age, which is anything that is less than 16 years old.

sections.label: GLS buildability and PPVC conditions
sections.summary: Some GLS sales carry buildability score conditions, and some specify construction by PPVC, which is not 100%.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: Some of our GLS sales come with a condition that they meet certain buildability scores.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: Now, we have some GLSs which specify that the construction must be by PPVC, and it is not 100%.

sections.label: Farmer tenure consultation and HDB flexibility
sections.summary: Consultation with farmers on longer tenure continues, feedback will inform tenure awards, and HDB takes a flexible approach to help families in need.

sentences.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
sentences.text: In terms of the question earlier about how we can increase the tenure to encourage them to be more productive, we are still in the midst of consulting our farmers.

sentences.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
sentences.text: The indication is that they would prefer to have a longer tenure in order to allow them to invest sufficiently.

sentences.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
sentences.text: We will take their feedback into consideration in deciding how we want to award our tenures and scope the policy accordingly.

sentences.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
sentences.text: At the end of the day, HDB does take a flexible approach to help families who are in need, even if they do fall within these schemes, the whole idea being that we want to make sure that they do have a roof over their heads.

sentences.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
sentences.text: We will monitor the situation closely and if there are cases that we are beginning to see more, especially at our Meet-the-People Sessions (MPS), that there are more families that seem to fall through the cracks.

sections.label: Reconducting survey if problem prevalent
sections.summary: If the problem is found to be more prevalent and increasing, another survey can be reconducted.

sentences.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
sentences.text: If it is picked up that this is a much more prevalent problem and is increasingly so, we can reconduct another survey.

sections.label: LBS expansion for 4-room flat owners
sections.summary: Expanding LBS to allow 4-room flat owners to join has catered to almost 75% of elderly flat owners.

sentences.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
sentences.text: At this moment, by expanding LBS to allow 4-room flat owners to join, we have already catered to almost 75% of the elderly who own flats.

sections.label: Encouraging APF use on lease renewal
sections.summary: As farmers renew their lease, they can be encouraged to use APF to change farming and upgrade technologies.

sentences.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
sentences.text: So, the persuasion part has to be there.

sentences.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
sentences.text: Certainly, as they renew their lease, we can encourage them to look at how they can use APF to further change the way they do farming, so that as they take on a new lease with a longer life span, they can then utilise the APF effectively to up their farming technologies.

sections.label: Thanks to Members filing cuts
sections.summary: The speaker thanks 20 Members who filed 43 cuts across topics including housing, construction, agriculture, animal welfare and hot springs.

sentences.speaker: Mr Alex Yam
sentences.text: Mr Chairman, let me first thank the 20 Members who filed a total of 43 cuts across diverse topics, such as housing municipal issues, construction, agriculture, animal welfare, and even hot springs.
